# See https://github.com/build-cpp/cmkr for more information

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_BINARY_DIR)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "In-tree builds are not supported. Run CMake from a separate directory: cmake -B build")
endif()

set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT OFF)
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT ON)

	# Bootstrap cmkr and automatically regenerate CMakeLists.txt
	include("../../cmake/cmkr.cmake" OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
	if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
		cmkr()
	endif()

	# Enable folder support
	set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY USE_FOLDERS ON)

	# Create a configure-time dependency on cmake.toml to improve IDE support
	set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS cmake.toml)
endif()

project(rengine_sdl_surface
	LANGUAGES
		CXX
)

find_package(SDL2 2.32.10 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)

# Packages
find_package(OpenGL REQUIRED)

find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

# Target: rengine_surface
set(rengine_surface_SOURCES
	cmake.toml
	surface.cpp
)

add_library(rengine_surface SHARED)

target_sources(rengine_surface PRIVATE ${rengine_surface_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${rengine_surface_SOURCES})

target_compile_definitions(rengine_surface PRIVATE
	RENGINE_SURFACE_BUILD
)

target_compile_features(rengine_surface PRIVATE
	cxx_std_17
)

target_link_libraries(rengine_surface PRIVATE
	SDL2::SDL2
	OpenGL::GL
	Threads::Threads
)

set(CMKR_TARGET rengine_surface)
if(APPLE)
  target_sources(rengine_surface PRIVATE interpose_macos.cpp)
  target_compile_options(rengine_surface PRIVATE -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
elseif(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(rengine_surface PRIVATE ws2_32)
endif()
# The fixture's source lives with the orchestrator tests, outside this project directory, which
# cmkr's source grouping cannot express; it is declared here as plain CMake instead.
add_executable(rengine_surface_fixture ../../orchestrator/tests/surface_fixture.cpp)
target_compile_features(rengine_surface_fixture PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(rengine_surface_fixture PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2 OpenGL::GL)
if(APPLE)
  target_compile_options(rengine_surface_fixture PRIVATE -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
elseif(WIN32)
  target_include_directories(rengine_surface_fixture PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(rengine_surface_fixture PRIVATE rengine_surface SDL2::SDL2main)
  add_custom_command(TARGET rengine_surface_fixture POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
    $<TARGET_FILE:SDL2::SDL2> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:rengine_surface_fixture>)
endif()
